summary: Brand refresh testing (bMART/bFOOD/bSHOP/bSEND/bAUTO/bIMMO). I checked the config API, the website in dark and light mode (home, /food, /shop, /send, /auto, /immo, shop product page, cart drawer, the search dropdown and the /search results page), the admin dashboard and the 6 module workspaces, the food partner login and dashboard, and the mobile preview (home tiles, module switcher, Explorer, light mode via Profile > Appearance, and the bFOOD/bSHOP/bSEND module homes). The main surfaces are correct. I found several old colours and names still in the code: bFOOD shows green on the /search results page, SHOP cart chips and the cart CTA are still amber/gold, bAUTO/bIMMO show a dark badge in dark mode, and the website logo images still have alt text like 'MARTbakēd'.

ui_bugs.issue: The `theme` prop is never passed to TextWordmark (line 61), so it always uses BADGE.light (a black square). In DARK mode the bAUTO/bIMMO website tabs, and any text-logo fallback, show a black badge on a black background that you can barely see. Fix: pass theme={theme}.
The image alt text is still the old name: alt=`${label}bakēd` gives 'MARTbakēd', 'FOODbakēd' and 'SHOPbakēd' on every page (only express gives 'bSEND'). Should be `b${label}`.

critical_code_review_comments: Module colours are duplicated as hard-coded hex values in 15+ files instead of using getModule(code).color from lib/modules.js. That is why so many leftovers were missed. Centralise them.
TextWordmark has a `theme` param, but its only caller does not pass it.
